documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of Postal_Ballot
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Management stated that the company delivered strong Q1 FY27 results with 39.5% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 404 crores and crossing the INR 4,000 million quarterly revenue and EBITDA milestone for the first time. Profitability grew by 67.6% year-on-year, supported by sustained demand, deeper customer relationships, and increasing contributions from value-added specialty fats and butters. The company progressed on strategic milestones including expanding its sourcing footprint in West Africa via Chad and Burkina Faso, completing a QIP to strengthen the balance sheet, and advancing fractionation and downstream CBA plant expansions. Looking ahead, management remains confident in long-term prospects, focusing on sustainable growth, operational efficiencies, and expanding its global specialty ingredients platform. Manorama Industries Limited reported a strong start to FY27 with a Q1 consolidated revenue growth of 39.5% year-on-year, surpassing the INR 4,000 million milestone and achieving a 67.6% increase in profitability.

guidance.claim: The company expects capacity utilization to be around 80% to 85% for the full year.
guidance.quote: So we expect our to be around 80%, 85% for full year for this year.

guidance.claim: The management's internal target for capacity utilization is around 80% to 85%.
guidance.quote: You can say that 80%, to 85%, the management internal target is around that execution level.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the pricing model for value-added products has remained largely stable in line with the costing model.
demand_outlook.quote: So our pricing model, if you say, has been -- remained stable largely, which is in line of our costing model as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Export revenue contribution remained approximately in the range of 50% to 60%.
demand_outlook.quote: And it approximately in the range only of 50% to 60% of export revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted sustained demand across key end-user industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Profitability increased by 67.6% YoY, reflecting sustained demand across key end-user industries, deeper customer engagement, and the growing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness sustained and growing demand across the food and cosmetic sectors worldwide.
demand_outlook.quote: This excellence in performance is a testament to the resilience of our integrated value chain, the global relevance of our specialty fats and coco butter equivalents and the sustained and growing demand we continue to witness across the food and cosmetic sectors worldwide through our scientific and high-tech products, which are being used all over the world.

capex_expansion.claim: A portion of the additional fractionation capacity of 7,500 has already been operationalized, with the balance intended around Quarter 3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: So we already have done a portion of our additional capacity of 7,500, which is already have been operationalized. And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.

capex_expansion.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Burkina Faso plant has an expected payback period of around 3 years once operational.
capex_expansion.quote: So we see a payback period, which should be around 3 years once the plant is operational in Burkina Faso.

capex_expansion.claim: Total proposed capex plan is approximately INR 460 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: out of INR 460 crores of our proposed capex plan.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capex plan for FY27 is approximately INR 225 crores to INR 250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ballpark capex guidance for this year should be around INR 225 crores to INR 250-odd crores of investment in financial year approximately in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans a strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years.
capex_expansion.quote: Through strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years, this investment program spans setting up of a new solvent fractionation manufacturing facility for Sal, Shea, Palm, Mango and other exotic seeds and ESOS.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 49 basis points year-on-year to 26.3% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: while EBITDA margin expanded by 49 basis points to 26.3%, supported by disciplined cost management, operational efficiencies and operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin expanded by 326 basis points to 19.5% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: with profit after tax margin expanding by 326 basis points to 19.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin broadly moves in the range of 45% to 50%.
margins_costs.quote: And our gross margin broadly moves in the range of that range only of around 45% to 50%, what we can say because a lot of time, it depends on freight cost timing also and our by-product realization, which is a de-oiled cake.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost run rate going forward is expected to be around INR 14 crores to INR 15 crores per quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But currently, the run rate, which we can take should be around INR 14 crores to INR 15 crores per quarter going forward. It should be generally in this line only.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA stood at INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%, reflecting focused product mix optimization and disciplined cost management.

orders_capacity.claim: Debottlenecking is expected to add an additional 4,500 tons of capacity in the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: So approximately, we are expecting additional 4,500 tons of debottlenecking in this financial year, additionally.

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity of 47,500 tons will go up to approximately 52,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: So our current capacity of 47,500 tons will be going to around approximately to around 52,000 tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the quarter was around 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: what we can share with you that we have done a utilization of around 80% on our capacity for this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Stearin volume was around 8,000 metric tons and CBE volume was around 7,500 metric tons for the full year.
orders_capacity.quote: Stearin volume was around 8,000 reported on a full year metric ton, and CBE volume has been reported around 7,500 metric ton for full year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully completed a qualified institutional placement (QIP) of around INR 500 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: And recently also, if you see, we have successfully completed our fundraising QIP, which was around INR 500 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company holds INR 150-odd crores in fixed deposits (FDR), excluding the QIP component.
capital_allocation.quote: We also have INR 150-odd crores FDR in form of FDR in company with us, excluding the QIP component.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores, ROCE of 33.6% and ROE of 40.3%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that Nigeria is one of the countries in Africa that has put a temporary export ban on shea nuts.
risks_headwinds.quote: So that is one country which has put a temporary ban.

management_commitments.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.
